categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three core business segments: (1) Automation Control Systems including DCS (Distributed Control Systems), SIS (Safety Instrumented Systems), CCS (Compressor Control Systems), and PLC (Programmable Logic Controllers); (2) Industrial Software including OMC (Operation Management & Control System), APEX (process simulation platform), MES (Manufacturing Execution System), and various enterprise automation systems; (3) Instruments and Valves including pressure transmitters, control valves, and analytical instruments. The company also operates emerging business segments in robotics, new energy batteries, smart coal mines, and smart laboratories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies are built on the '5T' framework integrating Automation Technology (AT), Information Technology (IT), Process Technology (PT), Operation Technology (OT), and Equipment Technology (ET). Key technical innovations include: AI-driven control systems with cloud-edge collaboration, industrial AI large models for process optimization, digital twin technology, advanced process control (APC), and integrated safety systems. The company employs IPD (Integrated Product Development) methodology for R&D, combining customer-centric design with market-driven innovation. Manufacturing utilizes both in-house production and strategic partnerships, with emphasis on digital supply chain management through SRM platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves process industries including petrochemicals, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation, metallurgy, building materials, paper, and food & beverage. Major customer segments include large state-owned enterprises (China National Petroleum, China National Offshore Oil Corporation, China Petrochemical), international oil companies (Saudi Aramco, Shell, Petronas), and industrial conglomerates. The company has established relationships with over 30,000 process industry customers domestically and expanded to 50+ countries internationally, with particular focus on Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic presence across all major regions (East China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, South China, Northeast). International operations span Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand), Middle East (Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE), Central Asia (Kazakhstan), South Asia (India), Europe, Japan, and North America. The company established a Singapore International Operations Center as its overseas headquarters and has set up 5S shops in multiple countries including Saudi Arabia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Upstream/Midstream: providing automation control systems and instrumentation for process industries; (2) Midstream: offering industrial software and digital solutions for production optimization; (3) Downstream: delivering comprehensive smart factory solutions and enterprise automation systems. The company positions itself as an integrated solution provider rather than a single-point supplier, offering end-to-end services from equipment to software to consulting.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic R&D focus centers on: (1) 'AI+Data' core competency development through industrial AI, large language models, and machine learning applications; (2) '1+2+N' smart factory architecture combining factory operating systems with PA (Process Automation) and BA (Business Automation) plus N industrial apps; (3) Four data foundations (PRIDE equipment sensing, OMC operation management, Q-Lab quality, APEX simulation) plus one intelligent engine; (4) International expansion and localization; (5) Emerging sectors including robotics, new energy, smart mining, and smart laboratories. R&D investment reached 907.8 million yuan in 2023, representing 10.53% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) Direct sales of automation control systems, industrial software, and instruments to process industry customers; (2) Project-based solutions and system integration services; (3) S2B platform business combining online digital commerce with offline 5S shop services; (4) Software licensing and subscription services; (5) Maintenance, operation, and consulting services. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by 179 5S shops (offline service centers) and an S2B digital platform for broader market reach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the market leader in China's process industry automation sector. According to market data, it holds 37.8% market share in DCS systems (13 consecutive years as #1), 33.7% in SIS systems (2 consecutive years as #1), 28.2% in APC software (5 consecutive years as #1), and 20.7% in MES for process industries (2 consecutive years as #1). International competitors include Honeywell, Emerson, Siemens, and Schneider Electric. The company differentiates through deep industry expertise, integrated solutions, and strong R&D capabilities in AI and digital technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large cap enterprise with strong growth trajectory. 2023 revenue reached 8.62 billion yuan (30.13% YoY growth), with net profit of 1.10 billion yuan (38.08% YoY growth). Total assets grew to 17.88 billion yuan (36.88% growth), and shareholder equity reached 9.82 billion yuan (86.86% growth). The company achieved profitability with net margin of 12.78%. Operating cash flow was 191.4 million yuan. The company went public on Shanghai Stock Exchange (688777) in 2020 and issued GDR on Swiss Exchange in 2023, demonstrating strong capital market confidence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on: (1) Industry-leading automation and digital solutions specifically designed for process industries with 30 years of accumulated expertise; (2) Integrated '1+2+N' smart factory architecture enabling comprehensive digital transformation; (3) AI-driven optimization delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, efficiency, and carbon reduction; (4) Comprehensive service ecosystem combining 5S shops, S2B platform, and professional consulting; (5) Strong R&D capability with 2,219 R&D personnel (34.28% of workforce) and 669 patents; (6) Proven track record with 30,000+ domestic customers and expanding international presence; (7) Commitment to self-sufficiency and technological independence in critical industrial software and control systems.
